data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘petros’ meaning ‘rock’ or ‘stone’. This name carries a strong and stable meaning, evoking images of strength and resilience. In the New Testament, the name Petar is given to Simon Bar-Jonah, who became one of Jesus’ twelve apostles. The name Petar carries the meaning “Rock, Stone” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Petar usually hope their child will grow to embody rock, stone and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Petar symbolizes the rock-like faith and steadfastness of St. Peter, one of Jesus’ apostles. Petar is often seen as a Roman patron saint and protector, and some believe that Petar’s intercession can bring divine aid in times of trial and hardship. The name also carries a spiritual meaning of being a foundation and support for others, reflecting the role of St. Peter as a leader and the cornerstone of the early Christian Church.
